job.title: Sales Director / Commercial Director - AML, KYC, Risk Solutions
job.description:
My client is a global software business that specialise in industry leading and award winning Fraud, AML and Risk solutions. 
They are expanding extensively across Australia and APAC and now require someone to head up the sales function based in Sydney.
 
You will be part of an expanding operation, growing a team and playing a key part in taking new products to market. You will be working for a dynamic and industry disrupting global business that has an extremely strong brand both globally and domestically.
 
Key responsibilities:
  • Develop and grow the business to become a world class sales organisation
  • Strong Leadership of the sales team
  • Develop and deliver strategic growth plans around existing and new customers
  • Establish and implement new processes, procedures, tools and training
  • Assist with pipeline management
  • Assist with creation and delivery of strategy for the region
  • Grow the sales team across APAC
  • Work closely with the marketing and operations teams
  • Hands on business development where required 
Key experience required:
  • Extensive track record of sales and sales management within a software / services / consulting environment
  • Experience of growing and managing sales teams
  • An understanding or background within AML, KYC, Risk
  • Experience of owning and running a P&L
  • Consultative approach to sales with executive level credibility
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills
  • Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills
This represents an outstanding opportunity to join an industry disruptor that is growing rapidly. You will have an extremely visible and strategic role within this company and be instrumental in it's growth across Asia. The role is available immediately so please send through your CV ASAP to chris.irwin@jenkinbeattie.com

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
• Australian marketing Start-up
  • $85,000 base + super + uncapped OTE's of $110,000+
  • Unlimited career progression - the opportunity to develop quickly
 
My client, a leading Australian Marketing business specializing in lead generation services, is seeking a motivated and dedicated Business Development Manager to join their team in the heart of Sydney CBD.
 
About the Company:
Our client is a premier marketing agency with a focus on lead-generation services. With a strong presence in the Australian market, they specialize in serving clients within the financial services sector, including insurance, lending, and brokering, as well as cutting-edge SaaS tech firms. As a Business Development Manager, you will play a pivotal role in expanding their market reach and contributing to their continued success.
 
Role Overview:
As a Business Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of the company's growth strategy. This is a full 360 sales role, empowering you to take ownership of the entire sales process from inception to close. Your primary responsibility will be to identify, engage, and convert prospective clients. With your exceptional interpersonal skills and persuasive communication, you will foster strong relationships and effectively showcase the value of our client's lead generation services.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Identify and target potential clients within the financial services (insurance, lending, brokering) and SaaS tech sectors.
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed sales targets.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through effective communication and regular follow-ups.
  • Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to highlight the benefits of our client's services.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to tailor solutions that meet client needs.
  • Utilize your expertise in high-volume telesales to drive efficient lead generation and conversion.
 
Qualifications and Experience:
  • Proven track record in high-volume telesales, ideally within financial services, insurance brokering, lending, or related industries.
  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated, driven, and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to manage the full sales cycle independently.
  • Experience in B2B sales and a strong understanding of the lead generation process is a plus.
 
Remuneration:
  • Base salary of $85,000 per annum + super
  • Uncapped OTEs of $110,000+ based on achievement of sales targets.
 
Location:
Sydney CBD - Enjoy the convenience of working in the heart of the city, with easy access to transport, dining, and entertainment options.
 
If you are a tenacious and ambitious sales professional ready to take on a new challenge, this is the perfect opportunity for you. Join a dynamic team and contribute to the growth of a prominent Australian marketing business.

job.title: Account Director - Banking Technology Solutions - FSI sector
job.description:
My client is a leading banking technology vendor that is expanding rapidly across Australia and the region. As a result of continued growth they now require an additional Account Director in Sydney to drive growth across several key banking and FSI clients.

This role will be tasked with strategically managing a small, high value portfolio of existing accounts across Financial Services. 

Key responsibilities: 
  • Managing C level relationships within your portfolio of existing accounts 
  • Solution selling, up-selling and cross-selling, expanding existing relationships and taking conversations deeper and wide
  • Achievement of quarterly revenue and customer satisfaction targets 
  • Effectively managing internal and external resources to include pre and post sales, marketing, bids and proposals teams
  • Development of strategic account plans
  • Responding to RFI's, RFT's, RFP's etc
  • Commercial and legal contractual negotiations
Key skills required: 
  • Extensive track record of sales excellence and quota/target achievement working as an Account Director or Key Account Manager, ideally having sold into the Banking and Finance (tier one/two) verticals.
  • Formal sales training and practitioner of Challenger, MEDDIC etc 
  • You will be a proven relationship manager and business developer with strong conceptual and analytical skills
  • Ability to create detailed account and territory development plans
  • Experience of dealing at multiple levels within clients up to C level
  • Solution sales experience with the ability to work in a fast paced, highly dynamic environment
Please send through your CV ASAP to chris.irwin@jenkinbeattie.com or call me for a confidential discussion on 0422678709.

job.title: Business Development Manager - Software & Systems Integrator - Mid Market Focus
job.description:
My client is a leading software and systems integrator that is truly a household name. They are well established in the market and have made a number of strategic acquisitions in the last couple of years, allowing them to take new and exciting solutions to market. 

This BDM role is focused on driving new revenue growth from new SMB and Mid Market (<500 seats) clients across all industry sectors.

Key responsibilities:
  • Directing and participating in initiatives that generate new revenue from clients
  • Identifying new business development opportunities, following up thoroughly on each customer commitment, prospecting, qualifying and developing profitable new account relationships
  • Creating and developing annual plans and participating in account reviews
  • Understanding the clients objectives, buying criteria and decision making processes
  • Engaging and negotiating with key stakeholders at all levels throughout your customer base
  • Preparing quality proposal/tender responses and deliver professional presentations
  • Maintaining a strong pipeline of meetings, presentations and proposals in order to exceed monthly/annual targets 
Experience required:
  • Proven track record of success, having previous B2B mid market sales experience, ideally selling technology or software deals
  • Ideally you will have 5+ years of B2B sales
  • You will have strong communication and presentation skills
  • You will have a demonstrated ability to sell complex systems integration solutions into business owners, MDs and Directors (both business and IT decision makers)
  • You will be able to demonstrate your professional proposal writing and presentation skills
  • You will possess a strong commercial and business background
  • Strong technical understanding and an ability to translate technical requirements and specifications into easily understood business concepts
This role will allow you to develop your career in an organisation that has a huge range of solutions for you to sell as well as an outstanding brand that is hugely respected and well known in the market. job.title: Sales Specialist - GRC & Data Governance
job.description:
Full Job Description
  
Our client is a Gartner and Forrester Leader in the data security, GRC and privacy management space. In a little over 5 years they have grown to >1,500 employees with >2000+ customers. As a result of growth they require a Sales Specialist – GRC and data governance to support their ever growing customer base across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and Japan.
  
Working alongside the JAPAC sales team, you will specialise in selling the company’s GRC & Data Governance platform, acting as the regional Subject Matter Expert (SME).
  
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Qualify inbound leads and new business opportunities
  • Scope and develop new business opportunities, utilising your own network and contacts in industry – end users and partners (channel and alliances)
  • Own the sales opportunity from qualification through to close
  • Present the company’s GRC and data governance platform – demo’s, POC’s etc
  • Pricing and contract negotiations
  • Respond to RFP’s, RFI’,s RFT’s etc
  • Present at conferences and industry events
You:
  • Are a proven enterprise sales professional or solutions consultant   
  • Are a Subject Matter expert in all things GRC and Data Privacy related
  • Have a proven track record selling and presenting to C suite executives and Heads of (Data, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Legal etc)
  • Demonstrate a highly consultative selling style with outstanding communication skills  
  • Are comfortable with high level customer presentations, software demo's, POC's etc.
  • Are comfortable owning the sales opportunity but not the day to day account management responsibilities
  • Will have experience working for a leading global SaaS vendor or consultancy specialising in GRC, Data Privacy, Data Protection, Risk Management, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Identity Management, Unified Threat Management etc. etc.
  • Are tertiary qualified, ideally within IT, Business or Law
  
What’s on Offer:
  • Opportunity to take a new product to market in region & build a business unit
  • Work in an open, entrepreneurial environment with the smartest minds in the industry
  • Change the way businesses manage information management and data exchange
  • Unlimited professional development
  • Competitive salary and bonus plan 
If this role sounds like you, please Apply Now or for more information contact me directly at: nick.jenkin@jenkinbeattie.com
